quests.name: The Kindness of Strangers
quests.description: Kindness is a powerful force, even in the face of darkness. Help Rumi and her friends spread kindness to those in need.
requirements: Gift 10 Huntrix based characters to random users

quests.name: The Power of Friendship
quests.description: Friendship can overcome any obstacle. Help Rumi and her friends strengthen their bonds.
requirements: Gift 5 UR characters to your friends

quests.name: The Resilient Spender
quests.description: Sometimes, spending shards wisely can lead to great rewards. But there's nothing wrong with a little splurge now and then.

quests.name: The Dance of Victory
quests.description: Victory is sweeter when celebrated with friends. Help Rumi and her friends dance their way to victory.
requirements: Win 3 battles with Huntrix characters in your team
